intended_use: Choose further practice on a missed booking constraint; no mastery decision.

conditions.allowed_aids: The complete fictional rule card remains visible. No outside booking policy applies.
conditions.collaboration: Individual first response; discussion after submission.
conditions.ai_assistance: No generated answer for the first response; optional discussion afterward.
conditions.timing: Untimed; 3 minutes is a planning estimate, not a score criterion.
conditions.access: Plain text or spoken response; no drag, color or speed requirement.

outcomes.claim: Select a room and duration satisfying all constraints in a supplied rule card.
outcomes.evidence: Choice accommodates capacity, equipment and required time.
outcomes.decision_use: Use the missed constraint to choose the next worked example.

sources.title: Fictional Harbor Library room card
sources.content: Room M: 12 seats, no projector. Room N: 20 seats, projector. Both are available. Book whole 30-minute blocks, reserving enough time for the full session. A group of 16 needs a projector for 50 minutes. No setup or cleanup time is required in this exercise.

items.claim: Apply all three booking constraints together.

source_refs.supports: M lacks capacity/equipment; N fits both; 50 minutes requires two 30-minute blocks.

cognitive_demand.label: apply
cognitive_demand.rationale: Apply capacity, equipment and duration rules to this request.

items.stem: Which booking meets every requirement in the rule card?
items.response_directions: Read the card and select one. One point for the correct choice; otherwise zero. No penalty.

options.rationale: Enough time, but M lacks the seats and projector; hypothesized capacity/equipment omission.
Capacity and equipment fit, but time is insufficient; hypothesized rounding-down error.

feedback.explanation: N's 20 seats and projector meet the requirements; 50 minutes needs two whole 30-minute blocks.
feedback.next_step: Explain the missed constraint, then retry with 10 people, no projector, 40 minutes. Either room for 60 minutes fits; do not force a unique room key.
